title: UpdateTarget

version.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

source.description: Why it is the target: pin (the pinned version) or channel (the channel's newest, auto-update being on).

description: The release the environment would update to: its version, and whether the pin or the channel names it.
